tweed-pr45.requirements: Add the public run --json option so captured commands emit a compact JSON receipt instead of replaying child output. The receipt must expose id, exit_code, record and log paths relative to the evidence directory, and workspace_binding as unchanged/changed/unknown. Preserve full binary captured output and its recorded SHA256. Preserve default non-JSON output replay. A child failure must retain its nonzero status in CLI exit and receipt/record; source mutation must be reported changed, never unchanged. This is only the compact run receipt slice of PR45; other recovery/recording/release changes are excluded.
